title: Resolution urging Albany to require warning labels on anti-aging skincare
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Assembly to pass A.10829 and the Governor to sign S.8598A/A.10829, which would require anti-aging skincare products containing certain ingredients, such as retinoids, alpha hydroxy acids and salicylic acid, to carry a conspicuous warning label about possible skin irritation or sun sensitivity, especially for people under 18. The resolution cites concerns about children and teens increasingly buying and using such products, which are often marketed through social media and beauty influencers.”,
